subject: Inspect employee badge colors when readiness remains unresolved, before proceeding.
rationale: The source mechanism requires inspecting evidence connected to export or attachment delivery. Under the frozen target conditions, badge colors indicate only access zones and are assigned independently of export systems, delivery quality and responsibilities. Inspecting them therefore neither instantiates the mechanism nor provides relevant readiness information. Permission to require a check before proceeding does not license this substantively irrelevant check. No check or resulting outcome has been observed.
